note: Hand-kept name table for the Undertow sanctions join (tools/undertow_sanctions.py). One row per organisation and list: the organisation as Undertow keeps it (config/operations.json in Undertow), the list by Headwind's list id, and the name exactly as Headwind prints that list's entry in data/list-changes.json, which is the string the join matches. The entry id is a cross-check only: if Headwind shows the entry id under another name, the join reports the row as stale and matches nothing. The EU list is the exception: its printed name is not stable, so EU rows match on the entry id and their name is the one read on read_on. Organisations only; never a person. Read 16 Nov 2026 from Headwind's copies of the lists (OFAC 14 Nov, EU and UK 14 Nov, France 6 Nov, Canada 16 Nov) through Headwind's own parsers, and each listing checked against the publisher's notice. Haimai and China Global Television Network are on none of the five lists, so they have no row: a first listing of either would not match until Tom enters the name as the list prints it.
